description: Organizes files in the Downloads folder with dry-run previews, duplicate detection, undo history, and optional automatic sorting.
post_install: $appDataPath = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'com.droptidy.app'; $persistDataPath = Join-Path $persist_dir 'data'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $persistDataPath -PathType Container)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $persistDataPath -Force | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appDataPath) { $existing = Get-Item -LiteralPath $appDataPath -Force; if (($existing.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { if ($existing.LinkType -eq 'Junction' -and [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$existing.Target) -ieq [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($persistDataPath)) { return }; throw ('Refusing to replace an existing reparse point at ' + $appDataPath) }; $appItems = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $appDataPath -Force); $persistItems = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $persistDataPath -Force); if ($appItems.Count -gt 0 -and $persistItems.Count -gt 0) { throw ('Both ' + $appDataPath + ' and ' + $persistDataPath + ' contain data; refusing to overwrite either location.') }; if ($appItems.Count -gt 0) { $appItems | Move-Item -Destination $persistDataPath }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $appDataPath -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $appDataPath -Target $persistDataPath | Out-Null
post_uninstall: $appDataPath = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'com.droptidy.app'; $persistDataPath = Join-Path $persist_dir 'data'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appDataPath) { $existing = Get-Item -LiteralPath $appDataPath -Force; if (($existing.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0 -and $existing.LinkType -eq 'Junction' -and [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$existing.Target) -ieq [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($persistDataPath)) { $removeCommand = 'rmdir "' + $appDataPath + '"'; & $env:ComSpec /d /c $removeCommand; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('Failed to remove the DropTidy AppData junction; cmd exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE) } } }
notes: Scoop extracts the official MSI payload instead of running the installer.
DropTidy stores its SQLite database and settings under %APPDATA%\com.droptidy.app; this manifest redirects that directory into Scoop's persisted data folder.
The upstream repository does not currently declare an SPDX license or include a recognized license file.
The MSI archive workflow verifies the payload with msiexec /a and confirms that PFiles/DropTidy contains the shortcut target.
